root_cause: Production Source Snapshot used Netlify MCP with --no-wait, so the transport step could turn green before Netlify had finished building or promoting the deploy. A later SHA readback then had to distinguish slow promotion from provider failure without provider-terminal diagnostics.
prevention_rule: For canonical production deploys, the provider side-effect step must wait for Netlify terminal completion. Only after that may release.json exact-SHA and browser interaction proofs run. Do not treat command acceptance as deployment success.
